### ⚡ Performance
- Running into new terrain no longer stutters — the world streams in without the frame hitches it used to cause.
- Big hordes are far smoother: up to twice the frame rate with 80 zombies on screen.
- Zombies far from you no longer cast shadows, which is part of what pays for that.

### 🛡️ Stability
- One glitched frame can no longer freeze the game for good — it recovers and keeps playing.
- If something does stop the game, you get a message and a way back to the menu instead of a frozen screen, and a button that copies the details for a bug report.
- A graphics driver reset (or waking the machine from sleep) no longer kills the game: it says it is restoring the picture and carries on.
- One player's bad connection can no longer disrupt everyone else in the room.

### 🌲 Survival
- Trees no longer flicker out for a frame while you walk past water.
